columns.comment: Onboarding case id (ONB-nnnnn).

columns.comment: Applicant id of the request (APP-nnnnn) - the provisional id before a golden client exists.
columns.name: applicant_id

columns.comment: KYC customer record created at go-live (KYC-...); null for applicants that never went live.
columns.name: kyc_id

columns.comment: dim_client version of the new client valid at the request date (live cases; null for applicants without a golden client).
columns.name: golden_client_sk

columns.comment: Golden client of the onboarded entity (live cases); null for applicants that never went live.
columns.name: golden_client_id

columns.comment: Client group of the onboarded client (entity resolution), else the group the applicant was linked to at intake; null when no group identified.
columns.name: client_group_id

columns.comment: Legal name of the applicant entity as requested (fictional).
columns.name: applicant_name

columns.comment: SMBC booking location of the request (ISO-2, e.g. SG, HK); join to gold.dim_booking_entity.
columns.name: booking_country

columns.comment: Client segment: Japanese Corporate, Non-Japanese Large Corporate, Financial Institution, Sponsor & Structured Finance or Public Sector.
columns.name: segment

columns.comment: Products requested, '; '-separated (e.g. Current Account; Payments; Time Deposit).
columns.name: products_requested

columns.comment: Number of products requested.
columns.name: n_products_requested

columns.comment: First / anchor product requested: Current Account (corporates) or Correspondent Account (financial institutions).
columns.name: primary_product

columns.comment: Product key of the primary product; join to gold.dim_product.
columns.name: primary_product_id

columns.comment: Date the RM submitted the onboarding request (grain date).
columns.name: request_date

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year of the request (FY2026 = Apr 2026 - Mar 2027).
columns.name: request_fiscal_year

columns.comment: Fiscal year label of the request, e.g. FY2026.
columns.name: request_fiscal_year_label

columns.comment: Request period vs the Feb-2026 KYC workflow migration: Pre-migration (before Feb-2026), Migration (Feb-2026), Backlog peak (Mar-May 2026), Recovery (from Jun-2026).
columns.name: kyc_migration_period

columns.comment: True for requests made on or after 1-Feb-2026 (the KYC workflow migration).
columns.name: is_after_kyc_migration

columns.comment: Stage the case is in or ended in: Request, KYC Docs, Screening, Risk Assessment, Credit/Product Approval, Account Open, First Transaction, or Complete (live and transacted).
columns.name: current_stage

columns.comment: Stage number 1-7 of current_stage (null for Complete); join to gold.dim_onboarding_stage.
columns.name: current_stage_no

columns.comment: Case status: Open (in progress), Live (accounts opened), Withdrawn or Rejected.
columns.name: status

columns.comment: Date the status was reached (go-live date for Live; closure date for Withdrawn / Rejected; null while open).
columns.name: status_date

columns.comment: True for open cases (in progress at the as-of date).
columns.name: is_open

columns.comment: True for cases that went live (client onboarded).
columns.name: is_live

columns.comment: True for withdrawn cases.
columns.name: is_withdrawn

columns.comment: True for rejected cases.
columns.name: is_rejected

columns.comment: Why an open case is stuck (e.g. awaiting documents, KYC workflow migration backlog); null otherwise.
columns.name: blocker_reason

columns.comment: Reason for a withdrawal or rejection.
columns.name: outcome_reason

columns.comment: KYC documents still outstanding on the case at the as-of date.
columns.name: documents_outstanding

columns.comment: Onboarding officer owning the case (employee_id); join to gold.dim_employee.
columns.name: owner_id

columns.comment: CRM code of the RM who requested the onboarding (RM001-RM120).
columns.name: rm_code

columns.comment: Requesting RM as employee_id; join to gold.dim_employee.
columns.name: rm_employee_id

columns.comment: True when the request was linked to an existing client group at intake.
columns.name: intake_group_match

columns.comment: Client group the request was linked to at intake (null when not matched).
columns.name: intake_group_ref

columns.comment: When the new entity was matched to an existing client group: At Intake, After Account Opening (found later by entity resolution) or New Group (no existing group identified).
columns.name: match_timing

columns.comment: True when the case belongs to an existing client group (match_timing At Intake or After Account Opening).
columns.name: matched_existing_group

columns.comment: Go-live date = end of the Account Open stage (first account open); null when not live.
columns.name: go_live_date

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year of the go-live (e.g. 2026 = onboarded in FY2026).
columns.name: go_live_fiscal_year

columns.comment: Calendar days from request to go-live (live cases only) - use MEDIAN / P90 over live cases.
columns.name: days_to_live

columns.comment: True when days_to_live exceeds the cumulative SLA of stages 1-6 (request to account open).
columns.name: is_over_sla_to_live

columns.comment: Date of the client's first transaction (end of the First Transaction stage); null when not yet transacted.
columns.name: first_transaction_date

columns.comment: Days from go-live to the first transaction (activation lag); null when not yet transacted.
columns.name: first_transaction_lag_days

columns.comment: Live cases: true when the first transaction came within 60 days of go-live (dim_threshold FIRST_TRANSACTION_DAYS); false = slow or not yet activated; null for cases not live.
columns.name: transacted_within_60d

columns.comment: Open cases: days since the request at the as-of date.
columns.name: days_open

columns.comment: Open cases: days spent so far in the current stage.
columns.name: days_in_current_stage

columns.comment: Open cases: SLA days of the current stage.
columns.name: current_stage_sla_days

columns.comment: True for open cases whose current stage has run longer than its SLA (over SLA right now).
columns.name: is_over_sla

columns.comment: Days the case spent in the KYC Docs stage (to the as-of date if still there).
columns.name: kyc_docs_days

columns.comment: True for open cases in the KYC Docs stage for more than 15 days (dim_threshold KYC_DOCS_STUCK_DAYS).
columns.name: is_stuck_in_kyc_docs_15d

columns.comment: Stages of the case that ran over their SLA.
columns.name: n_stages_over_sla

columns.comment: Stages the case has entered (1-7).
columns.name: n_stages_entered

columns.comment: Post-onboarding survey score 1-5 (5 = very satisfied); null when no response.
columns.name: satisfaction_score

columns.comment: Theme of the survey comment, e.g. Turnaround Time, Relationship Manager, Document Requests.
columns.name: feedback_theme

comment: Client onboarding cases (brief 5.6), Apr-2024 to Sep-2026: one row per onboarding request with booking country, segment, products requested, current stage and status (Open, Live, Withdrawn, Rejected), blocker, documents outstanding, owner and RM, the group match (match_timing At Intake / After Account Opening / New Group), go-live date (end of Account Open) and days to live, first transaction and its lag after go-live (transacted_within_60d), SLA position (over SLA now for open cases), the KYC-migration period of the request (storyline 7: Feb-2026 workflow migration) and the post-live survey score. Live cases are new clients and carry their golden client; applicants that never went live have no golden client (golden_client_id null; applicant_id identifies them). Medians of days_to_live use live cases only. Grain: one row per onboarding case.
